# 熊猫骑行实验室 (Panda Cycling Lab: LLM SVG Animation Arena)

> 基于统一题目“画一个熊猫骑自行车的 SVG 动画”，实测并对比主流海外与国产大模型生成原生 SVG 矢量代码与流畅动画的表现。

Website: https://panda.cduyzh.top/
Sitemap: https://panda.cduyzh.top/sitemap.xml
Full Documentation: https://panda.cduyzh.top/llms-full.txt
Author: cduyzh (Chengdu, Sichuan, China / 四川成都)
Author Portfolio: https://www.cduyzh.top/
GitHub Repo: https://github.com/cduyzh/panda-bicycle-svg-gallery

## Benchmark Overview

- Single-Prompt Standard: "画一个 熊猫骑自行车 svg动画" (Draw a panda riding a bicycle SVG animation)
- Models Evaluated: OpenAI GPT (6 Sol, 6 Astra, 6 Luna), Anthropic Claude (Sonnet 3.5, Opus 4.6), Google Gemini (3.1 Pro, 3.8 Flash), DeepSeek (V4, V4.1), Qwen (3.8 Flash, 3.8 Max), GLM (5.3, Flash), MiniMax, Kimi, etc.
- Evaluation Rubric: Total 100 points across 4 dimensions:
  - Panda Character & Anatomy (形象, 30 points)
  - Bike Mechanics & Motion (动画, 35 points)
  - Visual Appeal & Craft (视觉, 20 points)
  - Code Elegance & SVG Structure (技术, 15 points)
